title: Decision
description: One cube, barrel or tile-sale and everything that could satisfy it. Zero candidates means the move is illegal; exactly one means it is forced and must not be prompted.

need.description: Units this decision covers. Always 1: coal re-measures the nearest mine per cube and the market price rises per cube, so units cannot be collapsed.

candidates.description: Sources that could satisfy this unit, after simulating the depletion caused by earlier decisions in the same array. Empty means unsatisfiable.

forced.description: True when exactly one candidate remains. The caller applies it silently rather than prompting.
